Join the Magic
 Our Mission
 At Puratos, we create innovative food solutions for the health and well-being of people everywhere. As the global leader in bakery, patisserie and chocolate ingredients, we help our customers to be successful with their business, by turning technologies and experiences from food cultures around the world into new opportunities.
We are more than 10.000 employees in over 85 countries and a consolidated turnover of 3.1 billion euros (in 2023). Our passion for innovation, a pioneering spirit and the unique Puratos culture drive our solid growth and vision for the future This, along with our commitment to our local communities, is what makes working at Puratos so magical.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for:
 Regional ICT Infrastructure Support Specialist
 ( Budapest, Hungary or Bucharest, Romania )
 Your Mission
 The mission of the Regional ICT Infrastructure Support Specialist is to collaborate with both the regional and HQ ICT Infrastructure teams as well as the country management teams in the region to ensure group standards are implemented and maintained while ensuring the highest levels of business continuity and productivity.
 What You Will Do
 The regional ICT Infrastructure Support specialist is responsible for the general ICT wellbeing and business continuity for the various sites in the region
 Operational tasks : 
Above all else ensure business continuity
Ensure a secured environment is maintained for all sites within the region
Be the first point of contact for the country management teams offering support and training for local and group standard ICT solutions
Manage ICT assets in the region, plan and execute migrations for end-of-life systems
Monitor wide area network connectivity and performance in the region, coordinate with service providers and HQ and local teams to resolve issues.
Oversee daily operations by local ICT staff e.g. backups, monitoring of systems and local network
Manage hardware and software upgrade projects
Ensure the local network and systems are robust and reliable
Define the budgetary requirements for the coming replacement and upgrades of existing and new ICT systems
Coordinate and supervise the regional Active Directory and other security systems
Work with end users to identify issues and deliver required PC service levels and standards. 
Provide training and support to end-users and staff on computer operation and other IT-related issues.
Perform on-site analysis, diagnosis, and resolution of complex PC problems for a variety of end users, and recommend and implement corrective hardware solutions, including off-site repair as needed.
Install or move servers, computers and printers and other IT equipment 
Problem and Incident management using a ticketing system
 Projects: 
 The Local ICT Infrastructure Support Specialist is involved in or can lead local projects such as:
Migration of local acquisitions or takeovers to the global Puratos network
Management and coordination of local moves and office/factory extensions
Be involved or lead local general ICT projects
 Technologies used: 
Network Infrastructure (Cisco)
Server and storage Infrastructure (HP)
Microsoft on-premises stack (AD, Windows Server, …)
Virtualisation (VMWare ESX)
Microsoft cloud stack (Entra, Intune, Azure, …)
Video Conferencing Equipment
 What We Expect From You
Minimum 5+ years’ experience in a similar position 
Fluent English
Willingness to travel (approximately once a month)
Drivers License
Supportive and problem-solving attitude
